turns.text: Hi Kiko, aaj Explicit aur Recursive rules ko cricket score sequence se samjhenge. Tum cricket mein batting ya bowling zyada pasand karte ho?

turns.speaker: child

turns.text: ताईं

turns.text: Kiko, tumhari baat thodi unclear sunai di—please dobara bolo ya thought complete karo: game mein tum kya kehna chahte the?

turns.speaker: child
turns.text: मैं कहने चाहता हूँ कोई दूसरा गेम खेलते हैं।

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.text: Kiko, chalo “number staircase” khelte hain: main start aur step dungi, tum next number bolo. Start 4, step 3—pehla next number?

turns.text: मैं समझा नहीं क्या गेम है?

turns.text: Kiko, background noise main control nahi kar sakti. Game wahi hai: 4 se shuru, har baar 3 jodo—4 ke baad kaunsa number?
